title: Don't Steal a Car With a Cat Inside in GTA 6 🐈 #Shorts
description:
GTA 6 lets you pet the bodega cats in Leonida, but try hijacking a parked car with a cat sitting inside and it fights back. One viral clip shows a player getting mauled mid-carjacking and tossing the cat out the window.

Source: Windows Central, "GTA 6 players are ignoring crime to jet-ski with dogs and redecorate their bedrooms" (Nov 18, 2026): https://www.windowscentral.com/gaming/gta-6-players-are-ignoring-crime-to-jet-ski-with-dogs-and-redecorate-their-bedrooms-the-funniest-clips-so-far
